race.description: Movember - Men's Health Month C,G&E Hcp (58)
race.comment: KICK ON CHARLIE (6) brings the upside, having placed on debut before winning a Mdn at this track and distance, and although he now has to carry that form into a handicap, he is lightly raced and still improving. Major player. I STOLE IT (1) has the strongest recent ratings and his Gold Coast sixth reads better than the bare position, with the margin only two and a half lengths after being hampered at the start. The 3kg claim helps offset the wide draw and his wet-track record is sound enough for this soft setup. Can give this a shake. CRACKER ESSGEE (10) is the seasoned danger, dropping out of BM70 and BM62 races after a Toowoomba third on heavy ground, with Olivia Kendal having won on him before. Each-way. LORD DANILO (11) was plain at Kilcoy over 1900m but his Sunshine Coast Class 1 third two back was more encouraging, and the inside draw plus 2kg claim give him a cleaner platform back at 1400m. Not the worst.
